payload.description:
**Blocked by:** web sign-in and the Cognito token resolver.

GET /me returns the person and their organizations with status. The app branches: signed out, signed in with no organization, organization pending, organization enabled. Same hostname, same app, one branch. Delete the build-time tenantId and userId constants from web/lib/config.ts; the organization comes from /me and then travels in the request path.

**Done when:** all four states render against development.
payload.title: Branch the app on membership state
